verdict.rationale: Vercel's Workflow SDK explicitly supports building 'durable, observable applications and AI agents' on a managed platform, and scheduled ISR regeneration ('on a schedule') shows some background automation capability, but there is no dedicated cron/scheduler product documentation or independent evidence of long-running autonomous agent automations in production. missing for 10: explicit cron/scheduled-job feature docs, evidence of persistent background agent execution beyond ISR, and independent/hands-on confirmation that Workflow SDK automations run unattended reliably.
